sloka: तौ हि वीरौ नरवरौ सहितौ रामलक्ष्मणौ ।आगम्य नगरीं लङ्कां सायकैर्विधमिष्यतः ।। ५.३९.४२।।।।
transliteration: tau hi vīrau naravarau sahitau rāmalakṣmaṇau ।āgamya nagarīṁ laṅkāṁ sāyakairvidhamiṣyataḥ ।। 5.39.42।।।।

translations.english: "Both the heroes, Rama and Lakshmana will come and blow up the city of Lanka with their unfailing arrows.
